QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Starstruck Kentauruses
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2081002#, who is quite worried about the star that fell into Minar Forest.\r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081002# says the egg is being disturbed by the stampeding [★] Kentaurus monsters. Get rid of them so the egg has some peace and quiet. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated [★] Kentaurus monsters for #p2081002#. #p2081002# is relieved that the egg will no longer be disturbed.\r\n

0.0: Oh no, oh no! This egg's heartbeat is way too high! The sounds of all those stampeding monsters has my baby all riled up! Please help!\r\n

yes.0: Those #r[★] Kentaurus#k monsters have been stampeding around like their tushes were on fire. I can't do much about it, but YOU can.\r\n

no.0: I'm okay, but the egg is so distressed. All this extra noise is no good.\r\n

1.0: You did it! You taught those [★] Kentauruses to respect unhatched eggs!

yes.0: The egg's calmed down a lot. Whew. I know my hugs and kisses helped, too.

npc.0: The egg is upset by all the #r[★] Kentaurus#k monsters stampeding around. I better hug it tight while you take care of those disrespectful creatures.
